name: mb_search_buses
title: Search buses
description:
Intercity buses on a date: company, terminal, times, price per seat, free seats, bus type, stops, refund penalties.

A city id covers all its terminals. price_toman is per seat. Top-level refund_penalties
apply to every bus unless a bus lists its own (until_hours_before: step applies until then,
null = up to departure). Next: mb_bus_seats with a bus_id; other days: mb_bus_price_calendar.

origin.description: Bus city or terminal id from mb_find_place(mode='bus'), e.g. 11320000 (Tehran).

destination.description: Bus city or terminal id from mb_find_place(mode='bus'), e.g. 11320000 (Tehran).

companies.description: Only these company ids from `companies` of a result, e.g. [4, 16].

include_sold_out.description: Also list buses with no free seat.

name: mb_bus_price_calendar
title: Bus price calendar
description:
Cheapest bus seat per day for a route; days without buses (or not on sale yet) are left out.

Then mb_search_buses for the chosen day.

origin.description: Bus city or terminal id from mb_find_place(mode='bus'), e.g. 11320000 (Tehran).

destination.description: Bus city or terminal id from mb_find_place(mode='bus'), e.g. 11320000 (Tehran).

name: mb_bus_seats
title: Bus seat map
description:
Seat map of one bus: free seat numbers, seats sold to women and to men, and a row-by-row layout.

layout: one line per row from the front; seat = number + mark (none free, w woman, m man,
x not sold online); '|' aisle, '--' no seat, 'DR' driver. price_toman is null for most
buses: use the search price.

bus_id.description: bus_id from a fresh mb_search_buses result.

name: mb_search_taxis
title: Search intercity taxis
description:
Private door-to-door intercity taxis (whole car, up to 3 passengers) for a date, one offer per pick-up slot.

price_toman is for the whole car. Many city pairs have no taxis (e.g. Tehran-Mashhad).

name: mb_find_place
title: Find place codes
description:
Turn a city, airport, station or hotel name into the code a search takes.

flight: `airports` (Iranian IATA codes; Tehran is THR; prefer to XXXALL for domestic routes)
and `cities` (any country; XXXALL = all its airports). train: station ids. bus / taxi: 8-digit
city ids (11320000 = Tehran, all terminals). hotel: city and hotel slugs.

query.description: Place name in Persian or English, or a code, e.g. 'مشهد', 'tehran' or 'IST'.

mode.description: Which search the code is for.

name: mb_companies
title: Transport companies
description:
List airlines (IATA code), rail operators or bus companies (id) with Persian and English names.

Use to name a code seen in results or to find a code for the `airlines` filter. Bus ids
276/278/280 are the taxi classes VIP/Economy/Formal.

mode.description: Airlines, rail operators, or bus companies.

query.description: Optional name or code filter, e.g. 'ماهان', 'IR' or 'Iran Peyma'.

name: mb_notices
title: Site notices
description:
Notices MrBilit currently shows on its pages (disruptions, rule changes, payment options), for a service or route.

Route codes build the site path the notices match (/flights/THR-MHD, /trains/tehran-mashhad,
/hotel/mashhad). site_wide_active counts every active notice. Use before recommending a trip.

service.description: Which pages; any = every active notice.

origin.description: Flight: IATA code ('THR'); train, bus, taxi: English city slug ('tehran'); hotel destination: city slug or 'city/hotel' ('mashhad/enghelab').

destination.description: Flight: IATA code ('THR'); train, bus, taxi: English city slug ('tehran'); hotel destination: city slug or 'city/hotel' ('mashhad/enghelab').

name: mb_help
title: Help center search
description:
Search MrBilit's official rules, FAQ and help-center guides; returns the best matching passages.

Use for refund, cancellation, ID and baggage rules. Rules of one fare are in
mb_flight_fare_details / mb_search_trains / mb_search_buses instead.

query.description: Question or keywords in Persian, e.g. 'استرداد بلیط قطار' or 'رزرو خودکار'.

source.description: terms = official rules, faq = general FAQ, support = help-center guides.

full_text.description: Return long texts uncut instead of clipped.

name: mb_travel_guide
title: Travel guide
description:
MrBilit's guide for a route or city (summary, FAQ, article) and matching travel-magazine posts.

Route guide: service + origin + destination (flight IATA codes, train/bus English slugs such
as 'tehran'; hotel: destination city slug only). Magazine: query. Quoted prices can be out
of date.

service.description: Route guide for this service; needs destination.

origin.description: Flight: IATA code ('THR'); train, bus, taxi: English city slug ('tehran'); hotel destination: city slug or 'city/hotel' ('mashhad/enghelab').

destination.description: Flight: IATA code ('THR'); train, bus, taxi: English city slug ('tehran'); hotel destination: city slug or 'city/hotel' ('mashhad/enghelab').

query.description: Magazine search, e.g. 'کیش' or 'جاهای دیدنی مشهد'.

full_text.description: Return long texts uncut instead of clipped.

name: mb_search_flights
title: Search flights
description:
Search flights for a date: every bookable flight with price, seats left, baggage and times.

price_toman is one adult's fare (taxes included); total_toman the whole party. Domestic round
trips come back as two lists (`outbound`, `return`); international ones as packages priced
for both ways. Unpriced flights are only counted in not_on_sale. Next: mb_flight_fare_details
with the flight_id; to pick the day first, mb_flight_price_calendar.

origin.description: IATA airport or city code from mb_find_place(mode='flight'), e.g. 'THR', 'MHD', 'ISTALL' (all Istanbul airports).

destination.description: IATA airport or city code from mb_find_place(mode='flight'), e.g. 'THR', 'MHD', 'ISTALL' (all Istanbul airports).

return_date.description: Return date YYYY-MM-DD; omit for one-way.

name: mb_flight_price_calendar
title: Flight price calendar
description:
Cheapest one-adult fare per day for a route over a date range, in one call.

Then call mb_search_flights for the chosen day. Values are cached minimums and can differ
from a live search; days with no known fare are left out.

origin.description: IATA airport or city code from mb_find_place(mode='flight'), e.g. 'THR', 'MHD', 'ISTALL' (all Istanbul airports).

destination.description: IATA airport or city code from mb_find_place(mode='flight'), e.g. 'THR', 'MHD', 'ISTALL' (all Istanbul airports).

name: mb_flight_fare_details
title: Flight fare details
description:
Every fare of one flight with refund penalties, confirmed baggage, fare rules, notes and per-passenger prices.

Re-runs the mb_search_flights search (same route, date, party). refund_penalties: penalty
percent per window before departure, refund = paid x (100 - penalty_pct) / 100.

origin.description: IATA airport or city code from mb_find_place(mode='flight'), e.g. 'THR', 'MHD', 'ISTALL' (all Istanbul airports).

destination.description: IATA airport or city code from mb_find_place(mode='flight'), e.g. 'THR', 'MHD', 'ISTALL' (all Istanbul airports).

return_date.description: Return date, only for an international round-trip package.

full_text.description: Return long texts uncut instead of clipped.

name: mb_search_hotels
title: Search hotels
description:
Hotels and stays with a free room in a city for the dates, with the cheapest room price for the whole stay.

price_toman is the cheapest room for all nights (one room, after discount);
cheapest_room_sleeps is how many that room sleeps (often 1). Guest count does not change
prices: pick a fitting room with mb_hotel_rooms(guests=...). Next: mb_hotel, mb_hotel_rooms,
mb_hotel_calendar.

city.description: City slug from mb_find_place(mode='hotel'), e.g. 'mashhad' or 'kish'.

sort.description: Order; rating is the site's default.

min_stars.description: Only hotels with at least this many stars, e.g. 4.

max_price_per_night_toman.description: Highest price per night for one room in Toman, e.g. 3000000.

amenities.description: Persian words, each matching an amenity title, e.g. ['استخر'] (pool), ['پارکینگ'].

breakfast_only.description: Only stays whose cheapest room includes breakfast.

name: mb_hotel
title: Hotel details
description:
One hotel: stars, guest rating (0-5) and latest reviews, location, landmarks, check-in rules, amenities, FAQ.

landmarks: distance in km (drive minutes). Review text is cut at 400 characters unless
full_text. `hotel` is null after a numeric id: get the 'city/hotel' ref from
mb_find_place(mode='hotel'). Prices: mb_hotel_rooms, mb_hotel_calendar.

reviews.description: How many of the latest guest reviews to include.

full_text.description: Return long texts uncut instead of clipped.

name: mb_hotel_rooms
title: Hotel rooms and prices
description:
Every room of a hotel with its exact price for the dates: whole stay, per night, rooms left, meals.

price_toman is the whole stay for one room after discount (independent of guest count:
choose rooms whose sleeps fits). rooms_left 0 = full. Empty rooms = nothing free (try
mb_hotel_calendar).

guests.description: Only rooms that sleep at least this many (with extra beds), e.g. 3.

name: mb_hotel_calendar
title: Hotel price calendar

name: mb_city_hotels
title: All hotels of a city
description:
Every listed hotel of a city, sold out ones included, with stars, rating and address; no prices.

Filters apply to one page of 90 hotels at a time, so check `pages`. Prices:
mb_search_hotels or mb_hotel_calendar.

city.description: City slug from mb_find_place(mode='hotel'), e.g. 'mashhad' or 'kish'.

name.description: Only names containing this text, e.g. 'درویشی'.

page.description: Page of 90 hotels (the site's ranking order).

limit.description: Max hotels returned from the page.

name: mb_search_trains
title: Search trains
description:
Trains between two stations on a date with every class (wagon), its price per adult and free seats.

price_toman is per adult; for children, infants or a compartment call mb_train_price with
the class_id. Top-level refund_penalties apply to every class unless it lists its own. Stops:
mb_train_stops. No seats: mb_train_price_calendar or mb_alternative_routes. A round trip is
two calls (return leg with outbound_class_id).

origin.description: Train station id from mb_find_place(mode='train'), e.g. 1 (Tehran).

destination.description: Train station id from mb_find_place(mode='train'), e.g. 1 (Tehran).

date.description: Travel date YYYY-MM-DD (sales open about 18 days ahead).

quota.description: Seat quota: general (mixed), men, women, or car transport.

available_only.description: Hide sold-out classes and trains with no free seat.

outbound_class_id.description: Return leg of a round trip only: the outbound class_id (limits the return to the same rail company).

name: mb_train_price_calendar
title: Train price calendar
description:
Cheapest train ticket per day (one adult) for a route, only days with free seats.

Then mb_search_trains for the chosen day. Sales open about 18 days ahead.

origin.description: Train station id from mb_find_place(mode='train'), e.g. 1 (Tehran).

destination.description: Train station id from mb_find_place(mode='train'), e.g. 1 (Tehran).

quota.description: Seat quota: general (mixed), men, women, or car transport.

name: mb_train_price
title: Train ticket price
description:
Exact price of one train class for a party: per adult, child, infant, foreigner and empty berth, and the total.

A sold-out class still returns a price: check seats_left in the search first. The breakdown
does not add up exactly to the price; the price is what is paid.

class_id.description: class_id from a fresh mb_search_trains result.

empty_seats.description: Empty berths to buy for a whole compartment, e.g. 1 for 3 people in a 4-berth.

name: mb_train_stops
title: Train stops
description:
Every station a train stops at, in order, with the date and local time at each.

Takes a class_id, never a train number. The first stop can be before your station.

class_id.description: class_id from a fresh mb_search_trains result.

name: mb_alternative_routes
title: Alternative routes
description:
Alternatives when direct trains are full or dear: trips with one change, and nearby train, bus and flight routes.

with_one_change: up to 7 journeys with one change, any mix of train and bus (price per
adult). nearby_*: routes near the two stations with the cheapest price where known
(classes_listed is a raw count, not bookable classes); pass their ids to mb_search_trains,
mb_search_buses or mb_search_flights. Seat counts here can be cached: confirm with a search.

origin.description: Train station id from mb_find_place(mode='train'), e.g. 1 (Tehran).

destination.description: Train station id from mb_find_place(mode='train'), e.g. 1 (Tehran).

date.description: Travel date YYYY-MM-DD (sales open about 18 days ahead).
